courses.synopsis: This course exposes the students to the scope of tourism industry. Requirements of a tourist location. Role of transportation in tourism, tourist objects in Nigeria, exportation, role of marketing in tourism. Destination planning and development; study of group and wholesale tour operations which includes design, supplier negotiations and pricing aspects of tours. Uses of Foodservice in tourism.
